principles: One acquisition candidate is not automatically one unique Prayer work, printed edition, bilingual text, or public prayer choice.
Owner-path existence demonstrates repository presence only, not exact source text, reader availability, rights, or printing.
Current statuses reproduce the preserved B31 historical overlay dated 2026-10-29; this audit does not silently upgrade or downgrade them.
Canonical 48-prayer and 16-original-Novena inventories, 39 approved nine-door shelf routes and additional source editions are distinct lanes. Do not add them as unique prayer counts.
A resolved parallel or alternate devotion does not publish the held exact recension. AO-AQ-047 short Raccolta §40 remains held despite the public full Precious Blood chaplet.
No text, translations, source attributions, approval states, artwork, historical acquisition decisions or live app routes are changed by this audit.
